channel.title: Open Source on Dibi8 - AI工具目录
channel.description: Recent content in Open Source on Dibi8 - AI工具目录

item.title: Jev Ultrafast: TypeSafe Browser Agents That Fly at 7.1 Seconds — browser-use 2026
item.description: browser-use's Jev Ultrafast achieves 7.1s task completion using TypeSafe's decision engine. Dynamic indexed action space, CLICK/TYPE_TEXT operations, real Google Flights demo. 19K+ stars, MIT license.

item.title: Jianying Headless: Private Source Preview & Automation — AI Video Editing Without the App 2026
item.description: Jianying Headless brings CapCut's powerful video editing to the command line. Private source preview, batch processing, automation scripts. 2.5K+ stars, perfect for content creators.

item.title: Kev: Train Your Own Decision Models on Qwen3.5 — A Practical Framework for Small Typed Decisions 2026
item.description: Kev by Jared Palmer (React creator) turns Qwen3.5 into trainable decision models. 30K+ params, RLVR training, JSON/Pydantic outputs. Under 100 lines of code. 5.9K stars.

item.title: Laya-MLX: Native Apple Silicon Decision Engine — 13.4ms Typed Inference 2026
item.description: Laya-MLX brings Apple Silicon native inference to the Laya decision engine. 13.4ms latency on M3 Max, MLX framework optimization, Apache 2.0 licensed.

item.title: Laya: Non-Autoregressive System 1 Decision Engine — 33ms Typed Decisions Over 100 Languages 2026
item.description: Laya evaluates choice, score, and noul questions in a single forward pass at 33ms. 20K+ stars, Apache 2.0. Three checkpoints with Router auto-selection. Trained with RLCD against strictly proper scoring rules.

item.title: NiubiGEO: Open-Source AI Brand Visibility Platform — Monitor Your Generative AI Presence 2026
item.description: NiubiGEO by Albert-Weasker monitors AI brand visibility across LLM outputs. 4.8K+ stars, self-hosted GEO tool. Detect mentions, analyze sentiment, export reports. The open-source alternative to commercial AI visibility platforms.

item.title: Printfilm: AI Video Acquisition & Short Drama Platform — Content Creation at Scale 2026
item.description: Printfilm combines AI video generation with short drama creation tools. 2.2K+ stars, all-in-one platform for content creators. Script generation, AI avatars, automated editing.

item.title: SoL-Pi: Scaling Auto-Research Loops for Efficient Agent Harnesses — NVlabs Open-Source Optimization Framework 2026
item.description: SoL-Pi by NVIDIA saves 13.50/hour vs Claude Code and 5.71/hour vs native Pi. Four mechanisms: Action Fusion, ObservationPack, Evidence-Preserving Reducer, Online Context Compact. Free, opt-in, no patches required.

item.title: Tech WeChat Hub: Local-First Intelligence Platform — Real-Time Chat Analysis & Automation 2026
item.description: Tech WeChat Hub provides local-first intelligence gathering from WeChat with real-time analysis. 2.5K+ stars, MIT license. Private data processing, open source alternative to commercial chat analytics tools.

item.title: ZCode: AI-Powered Coding Workbench — Desktop, Browser & Terminal in One Platform 2026
item.description: ZCode by zai-org combines desktop, browser and terminal AI coding in one unified workbench. 6.5K+ stars, VS Code extension + web app. Multi-agent collaboration, real-time sync. MIT license.

item.title: AI Token Monitor: Track Claude, Gemini, Grok, Kimi Quota Live on Your Linux Desktop
item.description: Free open-source desktop widget for Linux that shows real-time AI token quotas with HP-bar progress visualization inside Conky. Supports Claude, Gemini, Grok, and Kimi with live API polling and reset countdowns.
